title: E-commerce Platform
shortDescription: A modern, full-stack e-commerce solution with real-time inventory management
fullDescription: Built a comprehensive e-commerce platform featuring real-time inventory tracking, secure payment processing, and an intuitive admin dashboard. The platform handles thousands of daily transactions and provides a seamless shopping experience across all devices.
problem: Small businesses needed an affordable, scalable e-commerce solution that could compete with enterprise platforms without the complexity and cost.

title: Blockchain Wallet
shortDescription: Secure Web3 wallet with multi-chain support and DeFi integrations
fullDescription: Developed a non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet supporting multiple blockchain networks. Users can securely store, send, and receive digital assets while accessing integrated DeFi protocols for staking and swapping.
problem: Existing crypto wallets were either too complex for beginners or lacked essential security features, creating a barrier to Web3 adoption.

title: 3D Portfolio Showcase
shortDescription: Interactive 3D portfolio with Three.js featuring immersive project presentations
fullDescription: Created an immersive 3D portfolio experience using Three.js and React Three Fiber. Projects are displayed in an interactive 3D environment with smooth animations and physics-based interactions, providing a memorable browsing experience.
problem: Traditional portfolio websites failed to stand out and effectively showcase creative technical skills in an engaging way.
